description.en: The Chinese crocodile lizard (Shinisaurus crocodilurus) is a unique, semi-aquatic lizard endemic to southern China and northern Vietnam. It is the only living species in the family Shinisauridae. Adults reach a total length of 35–46 cm, with a long, laterally compressed tail that accounts for about two-thirds of the body length. The body is covered in large, keeled scales, and a row of enlarged, spine-like scales runs along the back and tail, giving it a crocodilian appearance. The head is broad and flattened, with powerful jaws. Coloration is typically dark brown to black with lighter mottling, and the belly is pale. Juveniles have striking orange or red markings on the head and neck. This species is viviparous, giving birth to 2–12 live young after a gestation period of 8–10 months. It is a sit-and-wait predator, feeding on insects, small fish, tadpoles, crustaceans, and mollusks. The Chinese crocodile lizard is critically endangered due to habitat loss, pollution, and overcollection for the pet trade and traditional medicine.
description.zh: 鳄蜥（Shinisaurus crocodilurus）是一种独特的半水生蜥蜴，特产于中国南部和越南北部。它是鳄蜥科中唯一的现存物种。成年个体全长35–46厘米，尾部侧扁且长，约占体长的三分之二。身体覆盖着大型龙骨状鳞片，背部和尾部有一排增大的棘状鳞片，使其外观类似鳄鱼。头部宽而扁平，下颌有力。体色通常为深棕色至黑色，带有浅色斑驳，腹部颜色较浅。幼体头部和颈部有醒目的橙色或红色斑纹。该物种为卵胎生，经过8–10个月的妊娠期后产下2–12只幼崽。它是一种伏击捕食者，以昆虫、小鱼、蝌蚪、甲壳类和软体动物为食。由于栖息地丧失、污染以及宠物贸易和传统医药的过度采集，鳄蜥极度濒危。

anatomy.en: The Chinese crocodile lizard has a robust, somewhat flattened body with a distinct crocodile-like head. The snout is short and rounded. The eyes are moderately large with vertical pupils. The tail is extremely long, laterally compressed, and bears a double row of enlarged, keeled scales that form a crest. The limbs are short but strong, with five clawed digits on each foot. The skin is tough and covered in large, overlapping scales. The skull is heavily ossified, with a strong bite force. The teeth are pleurodont and conical, adapted for grasping slippery prey. The tongue is short and fleshy. The cloacal opening is transverse. Males have a broader head and a more prominent tail crest than females. The lungs are simple and sac-like. The heart is three-chambered. The species has a low metabolic rate and can remain submerged for extended periods.
anatomy.zh: 鳄蜥身体粗壮，略扁平，头部明显类似鳄鱼。吻部短而圆。眼睛中等大小，瞳孔垂直。尾巴极长，侧扁，有两排增大的龙骨状鳞片形成脊。四肢短而有力，每只脚有五只带爪的趾。皮肤坚韧，覆盖着大型重叠鳞片。头骨高度骨化，咬合力强。牙齿为侧生齿，圆锥形，适合抓握滑溜的猎物。舌头短而肉质。泄殖腔开口横向。雄性头部更宽，尾脊比雌性更突出。肺简单，呈囊状。心脏为三腔室。该物种代谢率低，可长时间潜水。

ecology_and_behavior.en: The Chinese crocodile lizard is a diurnal, semi-aquatic reptile that spends much of its time in or near water. It is an ambush predator, remaining motionless for long periods before striking at prey. Its diet consists mainly of aquatic invertebrates, small fish, tadpoles, and crustaceans. It also occasionally consumes terrestrial insects and small vertebrates. The species is solitary and territorial, with males defending home ranges. Breeding occurs in the spring, after a period of winter dormancy. Courtship involves head bobbing and tail waving. Gestation lasts 8–10 months, with birth occurring in the following spring or summer. Females give birth to 2–12 live young, which are independent from birth. The young have bright coloration that fades as they mature. The species is known to bask on branches overhanging water, and will drop into the water to escape predators. It can remain submerged for up to 30 minutes. Vocalizations are rare but include hisses and clicks. The lifespan in the wild is estimated at 10–15 years, but can exceed 20 years in captivity.
ecology_and_behavior.zh: 鳄蜥是一种昼行性半水生爬行动物，大部分时间在水中或水边度过。它是一种伏击捕食者，长时间保持不动，然后突然攻击猎物。食物主要包括水生无脊椎动物、小鱼、蝌蚪和甲壳类。偶尔也捕食陆生昆虫和小型脊椎动物。该物种独居且有领地性，雄性会保卫家园范围。繁殖发生在春季，经过一段冬季休眠期。求偶包括点头和摇尾。妊娠期持续8–10个月，在次年春季或夏季产仔。雌性产下2–12只幼崽，幼崽出生后即独立。幼体颜色鲜艳，随成熟而褪去。该物种已知会在水面上方的树枝上晒太阳，遇到捕食者时会跳入水中。它可以在水下停留长达30分钟。发声很少，包括嘶嘶声和咔哒声。野外寿命估计为10–15年，但在人工饲养下可超过20年。

habitat_and_distribution.en: The Chinese crocodile lizard is endemic to the mountainous regions of southern China (Guangxi, Guangdong, Hunan, and Guizhou provinces) and a small area in northern Vietnam (Quảng Ninh Province). It inhabits cool, clear, slow-flowing streams and creeks in evergreen broadleaf forests at elevations of 200–1,500 meters. The habitat is characterized by dense riparian vegetation, overhanging branches, and rocky substrates. The water temperature ranges from 18–25°C. The species is highly dependent on pristine water quality and forest cover. Its distribution is highly fragmented, with isolated populations in several nature reserves. The total area of occupancy is estimated to be less than 500 km². In Vietnam, it is known only from a single locality in the Yên Tử Mountains. The species is threatened by deforestation, agricultural expansion, water pollution, and collection for the pet trade.
habitat_and_distribution.zh: 鳄蜥特产于中国南部（广西、广东、湖南和贵州）的山区以及越南北部（广宁省）的一个小区域。它栖息在海拔200–1,500米的常绿阔叶林中凉爽、清澈、缓慢流动的溪流和小河中。栖息地特点是茂密的河岸植被、悬垂的树枝和岩石基质。水温范围为18–25°C。该物种高度依赖原始水质和森林覆盖。其分布高度破碎化，在几个自然保护区中有孤立的种群。总占有面积估计不到500平方公里。在越南，仅知于安子山脉的一个地点。该物种受到森林砍伐、农业扩张、水污染和宠物贸易采集的威胁。

habitat.text_en: Cool, clear, slow-flowing streams and creeks in evergreen broadleaf forests of southern China and northern Vietnam, at elevations of 200–1,500 meters.
habitat.text_zh: 中国南部和越南北部常绿阔叶林中凉爽、清澈、缓慢流动的溪流和小河，海拔200–1,500米。
